products.title: Ecco Men's St1 Hybrid Brogue Oxford
products.description: These fashionable brogue oxfords, created by ECCO, find out what happens when relaxed american style explores the harmonies and energetic contradictions that occur when extreme traditionalism is fused with iconic sneaker based comfort architecture.

dialogue.user: The **Ecco Men's St1 Hybrid Brogue Oxford** shoes seem to fit my criteria quite well. I'd love to know more about these shoes. Can you tell me a bit more about their features, such as the materials used and what makes them comfortable? I'm particularly interested in how they balance elegance and casual style.
dialogue.agent:
The **Ecco Men's St1 Hybrid Brogue Oxford** shoes are made from 100% leather and feature a rubber sole. They have a classic Brogue Wingtip design and are infused with premium materials and modern construction. The shoes are crafted from rich ECCO leathers and premium suede materials. They also feature FLUIDFORM Injection Technology and a foot-fitted last, which provides anatomical support and a durable bond between the upper and sole. Additionally, they have a single-density polyurethane (PU) SHOCK THRU point integrated into the thermoplastic (TPU) outsole, which delivers double the shock absorption and cushioning of previous ECCO SHOCK TECHNOLOGY.
